text_en: Then he brought me to the nave, and measured the pilasters; on each side six cubits was the width of the pilasters.
text_cn: 他领我到了圣所，量了壁柱，两边，各厚六肘；

text_en: The width of the entrance was ten cubits; and the sidewalls of the entrance were five cubits on either side. He measured the length of the nave, forty cubits, and its width, twenty cubits.
text_cn: 门口宽十肘；门口两边的墙，各为五肘；他又量了圣所的长度为四十肘，宽为二十肘。

text_en: Then he went into the inner room and measured the pilasters of the entrance, two cubits; and the width of the entrance, six cubits; and the sidewalls of the entrance, seven cubits.
text_cn: 他进到里面，量了门口的壁柱，厚二肘，入口六肘，门口总宽七肘。

text_en: He measured the depth of the room, twenty cubits, and its width, twenty cubits, beyond the nave. And he said to me, This is the most holy place.
text_cn: 量了圣所的尽头长二十肘，宽二十肘。以后对我说：“这是至圣所。”

text_en: Then he measured the wall of the temple, six cubits thick; and the width of the side chambers, four cubits, all around the temple.
text_cn: 他量了殿墙，厚六肘；沿殿周围的厢房，宽四肘。

text_en: The side chambers were in three stories, one over another, thirty in each story. There were offsets all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side chambers, so that they should not be supported by the wall of the temple.
text_cn: 厢房一层在另一层之上，共三层，每层三十间。厢房周围靠着殿墙，有突出的墙，为衔接厢房，免得嵌在殿墙内。

text_en: The passageway of the side chambers widened from story to story; for the structure was supplied with a stairway all around the temple. For this reason the structure became wider from story to story. One ascended from the bottom story to the uppermost story by way of the middle one.
text_cn: 厢房越高越宽，因为周围圣殿的墙越高越窄，为此上边的房间较宽。人由下层可登至中层，再登往上层。

text_en: I saw also that the temple had a raised platform all around; the foundations of the side chambers measured a full reed of six long cubits.
text_cn: 我见殿周围有一高台，为厢房的基础，台脚高一竿，即六肘。

text_en: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits; and the free space between the side chambers of the temple
text_cn: 厢房的外墙厚五肘。在靠殿的厢房之前的人行道，也宽五肘。

text_en: and the chambers of the court was a width of twenty cubits all around the temple on every side.
text_cn: 厢房之外有二十肘宽的空地，环绕着殿的四周。

text_en: The side chambers opened onto the area left free, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south; and the width of the part that was left free was five cubits all around.
text_cn: 厢房的门向着人行道：一朝北，一朝南；人行道宽五肘。

text_en: The building that was facing the temple yard on the west side was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its depth ninety cubits.
text_cn: 在空地的西面有一建筑物：宽七十肘，长九十肘；这建筑物周围的墙厚五肘。

text_en: Then he measured the temple, one hundred cubits deep; and the yard and the building with its walls, one hundred cubits deep;
text_cn: 他量了圣殿，长一百肘：包括空地、建筑物和墙，共长一百肘。

text_en: also the width of the east front of the temple and the yard, one hundred cubits.
text_cn: 圣殿的前面和东边的空地，共宽一百肘。

text_en: Then he measured the depth of the building facing the yard at the west, together with its galleries on either side, one hundred cubits. The nave of the temple and the inner room and the outer vestibule
text_cn: 他量了圣殿后边的建筑，连空地和墙在内，由这一端到另一端，共长一百肘。

text_en: were paneled, and, all around, all three had windows with recessed frames. Facing the threshold the temple was paneled with wood all around, from the floor up to the windows (now the windows were covered),
text_cn: 至于圣所内部和外边的门廊、门框、带棂的窗和三面的围墙，以及门限周围都镶上木板，由地到窗 —— 窗是遮蔽的；

text_en: to the space above the door, even to the inner room, and on the outside. And on all the walls all around in the inner room and the nave there was a pattern.
text_cn: 直到门上边，以至殿的内部和外部；周围所有的，里面和外面的墙上，都有雕像，

text_en: It was formed of cherubim and palm trees, a palm tree between cherub and cherub. Each cherub had two faces:
text_cn: 雕刻着革鲁宾和棕榈枝，棕榈枝在革鲁宾与革鲁宾之间；革鲁宾有两个面貌：

text_en: a human face turned toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion turned toward the palm tree on the other side. They were carved on the whole temple all around;
text_cn: 人的面貌向着这边的棕榈枝，狮的面貌向着那边的棕榈枝；全殿四周都是这样。

text_en: from the floor to the area above the door, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall.
text_cn: 由地到门上边，圣所的墙上都雕刻着革鲁宾和棕榈枝。

text_en: The doorposts of the nave were square. In front of the holy place was something resembling
text_cn: 圣所的门框是方的。在至圣所前面，有一座看似木头的祭坛：

text_en: an altar of wood, three cubits high, two cubits long, and two cubits wide; its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that stands before the Lord . ”
text_cn: 高三肘，长宽各二肘；角、底座和镶板，都是木的。以后他对我说：“这是在上主前的祭桌。”

text_en: The nave and the holy place had each a double door.
text_cn: 圣所与至圣所各有两门，

text_en: The doors had two leaves apiece, two swinging leaves for each door.
text_cn: 门各有两扇，每扇又有两页；可以折叠。每一扇门都有两页。

text_en: On the doors of the nave were carved cherubim and palm trees, such as were carved on the walls; and there was a canopy of wood in front of the vestibule outside.
text_cn: 门扇上都雕刻着革鲁宾和棕榈枝，像墙上刻的一样。门廊外的前面有木做的飞檐。

text_en: And there were recessed windows and palm trees on either side, on the sidewalls of the vestibule.
text_cn: 门廊两边，与靠殿的厢房墙上，有有棂的窗和棕榈枝，还有飞檐。
